agents.purpose: Interpret buyer intent, coordinate bounded shopping work, explain the selected plan
agents.context_scope: Buyer task view; approved offer and payment outputs
agents.prohibition: Cannot grant authority or send PSP commands

agents.purpose: Match specifications and compare evidence-backed quotes
agents.context_scope: Task-scoped catalogue and approved evidence; no payment credentials
agents.prohibition: Cannot finalize prices or execute purchases

agents.purpose: Explain eligibility and rank deterministic payment/reward calculations
agents.context_scope: Authorized quote and minimal payment-profile projections
agents.prohibition: No arithmetic from model text becomes an authoritative charge; no PSP credential access

agents.purpose: Draft seller replies and clarify this merchant's quote/fulfilment evidence
agents.context_scope: This merchant's participating orders and granted case evidence
agents.prohibition: Cannot view buyer cash cap, other offers or accept binding terms by default

agents.purpose: Separate claims, shared facts and uncertainties into evidence-linked drafts
agents.context_scope: Assigned case view excluding both parties' private agent memories
agents.prohibition: Cannot adjudicate, accept resolution or move money

agents.purpose: Produce reviewed-data learning candidates in an offline queue
agents.prohibition: Cannot publish knowledge or change live rules
